Title: 'The Abraham Accords have fueled war rather than peace in the Middle East'

Title: The forgotten French prisoner of 9/11
Subhead: Zacarias Moussaoui, who was sent to the US by Al-Qaeda to prepare attacks and was convicted of complicity in the September 11 attacks, has spent the past 20 years serving a life sentence without the possibility of parole in a high-security penitentiary in Colorado. His lawyer is requesting his transfer to France.

Title: Hedge funds increasingly speculate on French debt, raising specter of crisis
Subhead: Hedge funds now account for more than half of all European bond trading. France, which carries one of the highest debt levels in Western Europe, has become concerned about these creditors, whose profiles are less predictable than those of public institutions, banks or insurers.
